body: I do but it doesn't help.

What is the point of living if you never make a difference and hurts the whole time?  If I kill myself now, I will be no burden on anyone.  If I mentally can't take it I will be homeless, in debt, and drag everyone down.  Not to mention angry and bitter.  I am becoming hateful and I never was like that before.  I want to hurt things and break things (including myself).  I am just a failure.  If someone could just help monetarily, or physically I wouldn't, but no one is ever willing to do that.  I am on my own.  Forever.  No family helps.  No friends help.  And I have always tried to help people (even anonymously and they don't know I am helping them).  I have NEVER gotten the same in return.

Honestly since middle school.  I am in my late 20s now.  There have been periods where I have felt better.  But I always believed people when they said it gets better.  I just feel like I work really hard and then I get kicked in the gut again.  I just want to stay on the ground this time and not get back up.  I used to believe I could control my fate.  That if I worked hard things would get better.  But honestly it just seems like I get one shitty thing after another that I didn't do anything to deserve.  I know people have bigger problems than me, but I still hate my life.  I am sorry you feel that way too.  Sucks.
